name: contracts: define facet-scoped coverage, gaps and negative-evidence rules

description.purpose: Represent producer-owned facet-specific inventory accounting without implying semantic completeness or negative relationship proof.
description.limitations: A finite source inventory can be fully accounted for without establishing complete SCIP, configured build or runtime semantics. Negative relationship conclusions require an independent, facet-specific oracle.

schema.name: d_coverage
schema.description: A bounded scope assessment derived from producer-specific accounting

quality.name: bounded_facet
quality.description: Validate report fields against the precise versioned coverage schema and finite/unbounded universe constraints.

quality.name: count_conservation
quality.description: Rust must reject counts exceeding declared total and incomplete counts marked complete.

quality.name: no_negative_promotion
quality.description: No absent relation is proven merely by an empty index or complete declared inventory; require independent facet authority.

context.instructions: Never infer missing relationships as absence or convert self-hashed receipts into execution attestations. Feature acceptance needs independent Rust/native tests.

verifiedStatements.question: Can COMPLETE_DECLARED_SCOPE establish absence of calls?
verifiedStatements.answer: No. It means reported inventory accounting was complete for a selected finite scope. Negative call/behavior conclusions need separate evidence.

constraints.constraint: Do not convert a candidate, generic graph edge or review event into a stronger claim than the producer supplied.
Missing observations with incomplete coverage do not prove that relations are absent.
A self-consistent digest does not attest an independent tool execution or security impact.
